messages.subject: Beta version that displays errors
parts:
Hello Rhipe users,

Would you like to try a beta version that brings errors back to the R console
in an (I feel) easier to consume fashion?

After installing, try

library(Rhipe)

rhinit()
z=rhmr(map=expression({foo}),N=10,inout=c("lap","seq"),ofolder="/tmp/temporary",mapred=list(mapred.map.tasks=2,mapred.reduce.tasks=0))
f <- rhex(z,async=TRUE)
b <- rhstatus(f,mon.sec=5)
b

Since 'foo' is not present, this should throw an error.


Download: http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/tmp/Rhipe_0.65.1.tar.gz

Cheers

Saptarshi

P.S The code hasn't been committed to Github nor is this version on the website.
